claims.disproof_condition: 條件：下一份定期報告或說明資料寫出 PCB 化學品（沉銅、電鍍添加劑）營收轉為年減、或伺服器／資料中心相關需求轉弱；或板廠（客戶端）一手寫出改用別家化學品或自行替代。核查頻率：每季（定期報告、決算說明資料）。觸發後 48 小時：這條 claim 降 confidence，重讀電鍍化學品層讀圖的需求段與供給段。
claims.statement: Supplier-side statement (JCU Corporation FY2027/3 Q2 results presentation, 2026-11-05): in China, demand for PCBs and package substrates for high-function devices led by server-related uses was strong and its chemical sales rose sharply year on year; in Taiwan, server-related package-substrate demand was strong and chemical sales rose. Its main electronic chemical, via filling (copper-plating additive for PCBs and package substrates), is described as mainly for smartphones and PCs. Self-reported; no server share disclosed.
